'''Pokémon Adventures: Mewtwo Meets Its Match''' is the 36th monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapters ??? of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. The chapters that were originally released in this book were later compiled into the final chapter of {{PAV|6}} and the first two chapters of {{PAV|7}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
